_meta.title: Paula — Kohler Walk-In Bath
_meta.why_strong: Hits every dimension: named buyer, hard medical trigger (hip replacement), identity quote ('age out in the house'), brand-trust shortcut ('If you were trusted by Kohler, you're gonna be okay'), fixed-income financial frame.

persona.name: Niwot Paula, 68, recently-retired educator with new hip
persona.location_context: Niwot, Colorado retiree, owns home outright, planning to age in place
persona.primary_job: When I step into my deep Jacuzzi tub each morning since my hip replacement and feel my leg shake, I want to install a walk-in bath I can actually use, so I can age out in this house instead of moving somewhere I'd hate.

pain_points.label: Cannot stand long in shower
pain_points.description: Since hip surgery, standing for the length of a shower causes leg shaking and dizziness — has had to grip the wall every time

pain_points.label: Cannot exit Jacuzzi tub safely
pain_points.description: Cannot lift her surgical leg over the deep Jacuzzi edge to exit — has avoided baths for 4 months since surgery

pain_points.label: Fear of needing assisted living
pain_points.description: Identity-threat: aging-in-place is non-negotiable; daughter has mentioned 'maybe a community' once and it sat badly

trust_needs: Trusted brand name (recognized — 'Kohler' was the credibility shortcut)
Local installer with named technician, not a faceless 1-800 line
No high-pressure sales pitch in the home
decision_triggers: Realization mid-shower that she might fall before her leg fully healed
Brand familiarity ('If you were trusted by Kohler, you're gonna be okay')
Financing option that fits Social Security cash flow ($478/mo over 5 years)
objections: Worried installation will damage existing tile work
Husband not yet sure they need to spend $24K when they 'managed before'
persona.channel_behavior: Desktop in afternoons; reads full pages slowly; checks BBB and Google reviews before any in-home consultation

verbatim_quotes: I cannot stand up in the shower, and I cannot get out of our beautiful Jacuzzi tub.
If you were trusted by Kohler, you're gonna be okay.
